name: – Nicolás Pascual de la Parte – § 135 – Am 147
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 135. Recalls that terrorism, including jihadi terrorism, poses an existential threat to the security of the EU and of its partners; calls on the EU to continue efforts to prevent this threat with determination and full solidarity, in particular through greater coordination to improve knowledge, develop preparedness and response capabilities, and to ensure closer interaction with partners and other international actors; emphasises that the continued migration flows from third countries into Europe is leading to the import of terrorists and extremist Islamist ideologies, further undermining security in Europe;
